ai_summary: **Executive Summary: JSW Cement Q1 FY27 Earnings Call Transcript Analysis**  JSW Cement reported robust 15% year-on-year volume growth in Q1 FY27, largely driven by the successful ramp-up of its new North region operations, which achieved 55% utilization. However, consolidated operating EBITDA declined 7.5% due to substantial marketing investments (INR 33 crores) in the nascent North market, which recorded a INR 40 crore loss, and elevated fuel/packing costs. A material impact and key watch item is the net debt-to-EBITDA ratio of 2.95x, approaching the internal 3.0x limit, as the company embarks on aggressive capacity expansion plans totaling INR 7,500-7,600 crores.
